digest.component_or_area: LLM model capability overrides / Bedrock integration
propositions: The _MODEL_ID_CAPABILITY_OVERRIDES table lacks entries for claude-opus-4-8 and claude-opus-4-7, rebar's DEFAULT_MODEL, leaving them unguarded against temperature parameter rejection
Both us. and global. Bedrock model id prefixes for the opus line reject temperature and top_p parameters, but the override table currently covers only us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-7
Temperature rejection by opus models is conditional — temp=1.0 succeeds while temp=0.0 and temp=0.5 fail — indicating deprecated tunability rather than total parameter unsupport

The Anthropic provider path (anthropic:claude-opus-4-8) silently drops temperature via pydantic-ai but lacks the same capability override, causing Pass-2 verification to lose determinism when it pins temperature=0
Code-review passes pinning temperature=0 for deterministic verification run on claude-opus-4-8 without enforcing that the parameter is actually applied, creating nondeterminism in production
